assets.description: Compact bread-loaf and circular peace-symbol characters with expressive faces and stick limbs, drawn in the course’s monochrome outlined style.

assets.description: Two oversized round body-and-face characters with stick limbs and no separate torsos stand on a shallow tilted map of divided Germany. The smiling western character wears a top hat; the frowning eastern character wears a patched cap and worn shoes. The artwork uses the course’s monochrome outlined style.
assets.usage: Centered transition before the SHAP earnings interaction example. The map is an institutional analogy, not an empirical earnings model. Preserve proportions, transparency, and native map credit.

assets.description: Two round, torso-less stick figures examine a faceless Y-hat in the open cockpit of an intact, gently landed flying saucer. One investigator holds a magnifying glass; the other scratches its head. Sparse monochrome outlines match the course character family.

assets.description: Three equally sized round-faced characters with stick arms and legs and no separate torsos smile as they push three separate ballots into the single slot of one box labeled VOTE simultaneously.

assets.description: An outlined XG ligature, visible behind the swing, pushes a joyful, round, torso-less stick figure wearing a propeller hat. Monochrome line artwork on a transparent field.

assets.description: Two round, torso-less stick figures at a swing set: a figure wearing a plain dad hat pushes a joyful rider wearing a propeller beanie. Monochrome line artwork on a transparent field.
assets.usage: Opening title of the boosting explainer. Preserve proportions, transparency, full composition, and clear space; keep the title and explanatory text as HTML.

assets.description: Two round, torso-less figures inspect a nearly level wall-mounted landscape after taking turns to correct its tilt. Monochrome SVG artwork.
assets.usage: Static final pose of the title cartoon. title-picture.js renders the same characters in motion; title-motion.js manages a single automatic sequence with shrinking corrections, visibility handling, and reduced motion. Preserve proportions and keep the title as HTML.

assets.description: The Columbia crown in Columbia blue, with subtle face shading, a thin lower-right extrusion, and an edge highlight.
assets.usage: User-approved colored decoration for the homepage’s one-time idle coronation. The original monochrome course logo and its proportions remain intact; coronation.js changes only eyes, the I’s expression, and the crown. The colored crown is a purposeful exception to the default monochrome artwork guidance.

references.title: Columbia University header artwork
references.usage: Original crown path and base geometry; local blue shading and depth support the requested decorative animation.
